mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for three consecutive months triggers monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST) in late-cycle expansions signals weakening consumer demand and reduced construction activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently reduces consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdowns materialize.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates housing market collapse that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both decline, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY) forces central bank tightening that erodes corporate margins and increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.
